abstract: In 1932, Joseph Duncan argued in the Journal of Agricultural Economics that agricultural economists should engage more explicitly with politics. Nearly a century later, the political economy of food and agriculture has expanded in both scope and complexity. This paper revisits the evolution of political economy perspectives on agricultural policy, tracing the shift from early interest‐based explanations centered on farmers and consumers to broader frameworks that incorporate institutions, ideas and the interactions among diverse policy actors. We argue that contemporary transitions from an agricultural policy paradigm to a food systems one require a further rethinking of political economy analysis. Specifically, contemporary food systems pursue multiple and often competing objectives, including productivity, nutrition, environmental sustainability, resilience and equity, while involving a far wider array of stakeholders, from multinational corporations and transnational advocacy networks to technology firms and global governance institutions. At the same time, rising political polarization, populism, digital misinformation and the fragmentation of multilateral governance increasingly shape how policy preferences are formed, coalitions are constructed, and policy compromises are negotiated. These developments complicate traditional assumptions that preferences are driven primarily by material interests and that institutions can reliably facilitate collective action. We illustrate these changing dynamics through brief case studies of the 2024 European farmer protests, Brazil's Amazon Soy Moratorium and Mexico's genetically modified corn dispute. Each case highlights tensions between national sovereignty, global integration, environmental sustainability, and agricultural livelihoods. We conclude that understanding twenty‐first century food policy requires political economy frameworks that integrate interests, institutions, ideas and the changing geopolitical and informational context in which food system decisions are made.
abstract_zh: 1932年，约瑟夫·邓肯在《农业经济学杂志》上提出，农业经济学家应更明确地参与政治。近一个世纪后，食品与农业的政治经济学在范围和复杂性上均有所扩展。本文回顾了农业政策政治经济学视角的演变，追溯了从早期以农民和消费者为中心的利益解释，到纳入制度、思想及多元政策行动者互动的更广泛框架的转变。我们认为，当代从农业政策范式向食品系统范式的转型，要求对政治经济学分析进行进一步反思。具体而言，当代食品系统追求多重且往往相互竞争的目标，包括生产力、营养、环境可持续性、韧性和公平，同时涉及从跨国公司、跨国倡导网络到科技企业和全球治理机构等更为广泛的利益相关者。与此同时，日益加剧的政治极化、民粹主义、数字虚假信息以及多边治理的碎片化，正日益影响政策偏好的形成、联盟的构建以及政策妥协的谈判方式。这些发展使传统假设——即偏好主要由物质利益驱动，且制度能够可靠地促进集体行动——变得复杂化。我们通过2024年欧洲农民抗议、巴西亚马逊大豆暂停令以及墨西哥转基因玉米争端的简要案例研究，阐释了这些变化中的动态。每个案例都凸显了国家主权、全球一体化、环境可持续性与农业生计之间的张力。我们得出结论，理解21世纪的食品政策需要整合利益、制度、思想以及食品系统决策所处的不断变化的地缘政治和信息背景的政治经济学框架。
title: Revisiting the Political Economy of Agriculture in 21st Century Food Systems
title_zh: 重访21世纪粮食系统中的农业政治经济学

abstract: Evaluation systems often seek to reduce bias, prevent manipulation, preserve relevant information, maintain comparability, and treat candidates equally, but these fairness goals can conflict. This paper develops a framework for understanding such trade-offs in expert evaluation—including peer review, grant panels, academic hiring, and artistic competitions—where quality is multidimensional and legitimate disagreement among evaluators is possible. We treat the choice among evaluation procedures as a problem of constitutional design: rules must be selected before the specific candidates, evaluators, and circumstances that will test them are known. Classical music competitions are our primary analytical setting because their rules, scores, and controversies make these trade-offs unusually visible, but the framework applies to other settings in which expert judgments are aggregated under incomplete information. The framework highlights two core tensions: information control and outlier rules. First, when information is both quality-relevant and identity-revealing, procedures that suppress bias-relevant cues may also remove information with genuine evaluative content. Second, because sincere minority judgment and strategic manipulation can generate similar observed score patterns, score-based exclusion rules may reduce manipulation while limiting legitimate dissent. Two further trade-offs concerning transparency and standardization are developed as illustrations. The analysis shows that no procedure can eliminate all vulnerabilities at once. Beyond this design implication, the framework also helps explain why evaluation rules differ across stages and settings, and why well-intentioned reforms may create new vulnerabilities.
abstract_zh: 评估体系往往力求减少偏见、防止操纵、保留相关信息、维持可比性并平等对待候选人，但这些公平目标之间可能相互冲突。本文构建了一个框架，用以理解专家评估中的此类权衡——包括同行评审、资助评审小组、学术招聘和艺术竞赛——在这些场景中，质量是多维度的，且评审者之间存在合理的意见分歧。我们将评估程序的选择视为一项宪法设计问题：规则必须在具体候选人、评审者及可能检验这些规则的情境被知晓之前选定。古典音乐比赛是我们的主要分析场景，因为其规则、评分和争议使这些权衡异常清晰可见，但该框架同样适用于其他在信息不完整条件下汇总专家判断的情境。该框架突出了两个核心张力：信息控制与离群值规则。首先，当信息既与质量相关又揭示身份时，抑制偏见相关线索的程序也可能移除具有真实评价内容的信息。其次，由于真诚的少数派判断与策略性操纵可能产生相似的观察得分模式，基于得分的排除规则可能在减少操纵的同时限制合法的异议。另外两个关于透明度和标准化的权衡作为示例加以阐述。分析表明，没有任何程序能同时消除所有脆弱性。除这一设计启示外，该框架还有助于解释为何评估规则在不同阶段和情境中存在差异，以及为何出于善意的改革可能引发新的脆弱性。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Fairness trade-offs in expert evaluation: information, judgment, and procedural design
title_zh: 专家评价中的公平性权衡：信息、判断与程序设计

abstract: Hydrogeological disasters are an increasingly important source of fiscal stress for local governments, yet evidence on how municipal budgets adjust to these events remains limited. This paper estimates the fiscal effects of hydrogeological State of Emergency declarations on Italian municipal budgets over 2016–2022, exploiting their staggered timing across municipalities. We find that treated municipalities increase both total revenues and total expenditures after first exposure. The response is primarily investment-led, with capital expenditures accounting for the largest estimated component of the adjustment while current expenditures remain broadly unchanged. The largest changes in expenditure composition involve civil protection activities and sustainable development. On the revenue side, the adjustment is driven mainly by capital revenues and intergovernmental transfers. We further examine municipal heterogeneity using an ex-ante measure of fiscal resilience based on debt-service burden and tax autonomy. Municipalities with lower debt-service burden display sharper immediate fiscal adjustments, whereas tax autonomy matters more for sustaining the fiscal response over time. The weakest responses are observed among municipalities combining high debt-service burden with weak tax autonomy. Overall, the evidence suggests that hydrogeological emergencies trigger a structured, investment-led fiscal response, but that pre-existing fiscal conditions shape local governments’ capacity to absorb and manage these disaster-related fiscal pressures.
abstract_zh: 水文地质灾害日益成为地方政府财政压力的重要来源，然而关于市政预算如何应对这些事件的证据仍然有限。本文利用2016至2022年间意大利各市镇宣布水文地质紧急状态的交错时间安排，估计了其对市政预算的财政影响。我们发现，首次经历此类事件后，受影响的市镇总收入和总支出均有所增加。这一反应主要以投资为导向，资本支出构成调整中最大的估计组成部分，而经常性支出基本保持不变。支出结构变化最大的领域涉及民防活动和可持续发展。在收入方面，调整主要由资本收入和政府间转移支付驱动。我们进一步利用基于债务负担和税收自主权的事前财政韧性指标考察了市镇间的异质性。债务负担较低的市镇表现出更明显的即时财政调整，而税收自主权对维持财政反应的持续性更为重要。在债务负担高且税收自主权弱的市镇中，财政反应最为微弱。总体而言，证据表明水文地质紧急事件触发了结构化的、以投资为导向的财政反应，但既有的财政状况塑造了地方政府吸收和管理这些灾害相关财政压力的能力。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Floods, Public Budgets and Fiscal Resilience: Evidence from Italian Municipalities
title_zh: 洪水、公共预算与财政韧性：来自意大利市政的证据

abstract: This paper investigates the impacts of housing purchase restrictions on internal migration and household tenure choices in Chinese cities. We develop a spatial model that incorporates individuals’ migration and tenure decisions across cities. The model predicts that potentially affected homebuyers will either switch destinations or change tenure choices, depending on heterogeneous city characteristics. Utilizing the China Migrants Dynamic Survey and a difference-in-differences approach, we examine the model’s implications and find that the restrictions lead to a decrease in migration inflows and a reduced proportion of homeowners among migrants in the restricted cities relative to the unrestricted ones. However, this overall pattern masks important heterogeneity across cities: incoming migrants are more likely to adjust their tenure choices when restricted cities offer better development prospects or desirable living conditions, and they are more inclined to relocate to alternative destinations when such attributes are lacking. These findings highlight the importance of considering unintended consequences on migration when designing housing policies.

title: Housing restriction policies and internal migration
title_zh: 住房限制政策与内部迁移

abstract: When observing spatial data, what standard errors should we report? Within a finite population framework, we identify three channels of possible spatial correlation: sampling scheme, assignment design, and model specification. The Eicker-Huber-White standard error, cluster-robust standard error, and spatial-correlation robust inference are compared under different combinations of the three channels. We prove a finite population central limit theorem for weakly dependent random fields that bridges the gap between superpopulation and finite population inference in our unified framework. These limit theorems are then applied to derive the asymptotic distribution of M-estimators and functions of M-estimators. Based on the decomposition of the finite population variance-covariance matrix of M-estimators, standard errors should be adjusted for spatial correlation when effective assignment variables are spatially correlated and/or spillover effects are specified in the model. In the special case where the sampling probabilities approach zero in the limit, the Eicker-Huber-White and cluster-robust standard errors would be close to the spatial-correlation robust standard errors regardless of the spatial correlation among assignment variables.
abstract_zh: 在观测空间数据时，我们应报告何种标准误？在有限总体框架内，我们识别了可能产生空间相关性的三个渠道：抽样方案、分配设计和模型设定。我们比较了在不同组合下的Eicker-Huber-White标准误、聚类稳健标准误和空间相关稳健推断。我们证明了弱依赖随机场的有限总体中心极限定理，该定理在我们的统一框架中弥合了超总体与有限总体推断之间的差距。这些极限定理随后被应用于推导M估计量及其函数的渐近分布。基于M估计量有限总体方差-协方差矩阵的分解，当有效分配变量存在空间相关性且/或模型中设定了溢出效应时，标准误应针对空间相关性进行调整。在抽样概率极限趋近于零的特殊情况下，无论分配变量间的空间相关性如何，Eicker-Huber-White和聚类稳健标准误将接近空间相关稳健标准误。
title: A design-based approach to spatial correlation
title_zh: 基于设计的方法处理空间相关性

abstract: Conventional approaches to policy design fail to recognise the plasticity of citizens’ beliefs and social preferences. Based on a representative sample from Germany, this column shows that mandated carbon-reducing lifestyle changes such as limiting heating and the use of cars in city centres may crowd out pre-existing green values. Effective climate policy design requires recognising that (a) to succeed, essential policies including bans, carbon taxes, and the promotion of new technologies must be both implementable and politically sustainable, entailing (b) a critical role for citizens’ green values, which (c) may be either diminished or cultivated, depending on policy design.
abstract_zh: 传统的政策设计方法未能认识到公民信念和社会偏好的可塑性。基于德国代表性样本，本专栏指出，诸如限制供暖和市中心汽车使用等强制性的碳减排生活方式改变，可能会挤出既有的绿色价值观。有效的气候政策设计需认识到：（a）要取得成功，包括禁令、碳税及新技术推广在内的关键政策必须既可行又具有政治可持续性，这要求（b）公民的绿色价值观发挥关键作用，而（c）这些价值观可能因政策设计的不同而被削弱或培育。
title: Climate policy may crowd out green values and what to do about it
title_zh: 气候政策可能挤出绿色价值观及其应对之策

abstract: Economists have long viewed monetary policy as influencing labour demand, with little effect on labour supply. This column discusses four studies that use different methods and data from the US, the UK, the euro area, and Australia, and independently find that monetary tightening induces households to adjust their labour supply. Adjustment margins include hours worked, labour market participation, job search, and household balance sheets. These findings illustrate that labour supply is a quantitatively meaningful channel of monetary transmission that has implications for the resilience of labour markets, the interaction of monetary and fiscal policy, and macroeconomic models of monetary transmission.
abstract_zh: 经济学家长期以来将货币政策视为影响劳动力需求的因素，而对劳动力供给的影响甚微。本专栏讨论了四项研究，这些研究采用不同方法和来自美国、英国、欧元区及澳大利亚的数据，并独立发现货币紧缩促使家庭调整其劳动力供给。调整的边际包括工作时间、劳动力市场参与度、求职活动以及家庭资产负债表。这些发现表明，劳动力供给是货币传导中一个数量上重要的渠道，对劳动力市场的韧性、货币与财政政策的相互作用以及货币传导的宏观经济模型具有启示意义。
authors: Francesco Bloise, Cristiano Cantore, Mitali Das, Filippo Ferroni, Sebastian Graves, Jonathan Hambur, Klaus Hellwig, Christopher Huckfeldt, Mirko Licchetta, Haroon Mumtaz, Giuseppe Ragusa, John Spray, Eric T. Swanson, Angeliki Theophilopoulou
title: Uncovering the labour supply channel of monetary transmission
title_zh: 揭示货币政策传导的劳动供给渠道

abstract: We show that product and service quality serve as a hidden margin of adjustment to minimum wage hikes in hyper-competitive digital markets. Leveraging granular trans- action data from 2628 Tmall stores in rural China from 2015 to 2020, combined with household surveys and firm-level data, we exploit staggered city-level minimum wage in- creases and find that in the short run, firms neither reduce employment nor significantly raise prices. Instead, they systematically degrade quality, as evidenced by worse product ratings, slower logistics, and poorer customer service, starting within two quarters and per- sisting over time. The reduction in intermediate inputs compromises product quality, while cuts to outsourced IT services undermine service quality by weakening operational effi- ciency. Crucially, this decline is driven by high-quality incumbents, whereas low-quality firms show no change but are more likely to exit the market following the shock. These re- sults reveal a trade-off between labor income and consumer welfare, a cost that is invisible in traditional labor market evaluations but central to a complete welfare assessment.
abstract_zh: 我们证明，在高度竞争的数字市场中，产品和服务质量构成了对最低工资上调的一种隐性调整边际。利用2015年至2020年中国农村2628家天猫店铺的细粒度交易数据，结合家庭调查和企业层面数据，我们利用城市层面最低工资的分阶段上调，发现短期内企业既未减少就业，也未显著提高价格。相反，他们系统性地降低了质量，表现为产品评分下降、物流速度减慢和客户服务变差，这些变化在两个月内开始显现并持续存在。中间投入的减少损害了产品质量，而外包IT服务的削减则通过削弱运营效率损害了服务质量。关键在于，这种下降是由高质量在位企业驱动的，而低质量企业虽无变化，但在冲击后更可能退出市场。这些结果揭示了劳动收入与消费者福利之间的权衡，这一成本在传统劳动力市场评估中不可见，但对于全面的福利评估至关重要。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: When wages rise, quality falls: Minimum wages and the hidden trade-off in competitive e-commerce markets
title_zh: 工资上涨，质量下降：最低工资与竞争性电商市场中的隐性权衡

abstract: Demand-side food policies are increasingly recognized as important tools for aligning consumption patterns with climate change mitigation targets, and carbon food labels have attracted growing attention as a potential policy instrument. However, evidence on their effectiveness remains mixed, and causal evaluation results from assessing the effects of carbon food labels in real-world supermarket settings is scarce. This study presents evidence from pre-registered randomized field-embedded survey experiment with behavioral outcomes, combining a representative sample of 2,372 Swiss residents with transaction-level purchasing data covering more than five million daily food purchase decisions made by 1,601 consumers over several years. In collaboration with one of Switzerland’s largest grocery retailers, we evaluate the causal impact of an information treatment designed to increase awareness of one of the world’s first carbon food labels implemented in grocery stores on both stated preferences and revealed purchasing behavior. The results show that the information treatment significantly increases label awareness and leads to small but positive effects on attitudes, perceived behavioral control, and intentions to consider the climate compatibility of food purchases. When tracing these effects into revealed purchasing behavior, the treatment also affects actual food purchases, but effects are modest and heterogeneous across food categories. Rather than inducing broad shifts away from meat consumption, the information treatment primarily leads to a higher overall share of labeled products purchased, increased purchases of labeled convenience products, and a partial reallocation within meat consumption (e.g., lower beef and higher pork purchases). We find no evidence of substantial reductions in overall meat purchases or large cross-category substitutions toward plant-based foods. While heavy meat eaters do not react negatively to the treatment, men and more right-wing individuals show a modest behavioral backlash. Overall, the results suggest that carbon food labels capacity to substantially alter habitual food consumption patterns in stimulus-intensive retail environments is limited and should be thus complemented by additional demand-side measures.
abstract_zh: 需求侧食品政策日益被认为是使消费模式与气候变化减缓目标相一致的重要工具，碳食品标签作为一种潜在的政策手段也引起了越来越多的关注。然而，关于其有效性的证据仍然不一，且在真实超市环境中评估碳食品标签影响的因果评价结果十分稀缺。本研究提供了来自预注册的随机实地嵌入调查实验的证据，并结合行为结果，涵盖了2，372名瑞士居民的代表性样本，以及包含1，601名消费者多年间超过五百万次日常食品购买决策的交易级购买数据。我们与瑞士最大的杂货零售商之一合作，评估了一项旨在提高对杂货店中全球首批碳食品标签之一认知度的信息干预对陈述偏好和揭示性购买行为的因果影响。结果显示，信息干预显著提高了标签认知度，并对态度、感知行为控制以及考虑食品购买气候兼容性的意图产生了虽小但积极的影响。在将这些影响追踪至揭示性购买行为时，干预也影响了实际食品购买，但效果温和且在不同食品类别间存在异质性。信息干预并未引发远离肉类消费的广泛转变，而是主要导致所购标签产品总体份额增加、标签便利产品购买量上升，以及肉类消费内部的部分重新分配（例如，牛肉购买减少而猪肉购买增加）。我们未发现总体肉类购买量大幅减少或向植物基食品大规模跨类别替代的证据。尽管重度肉类消费者对干预未表现出负面反应，但男性和更倾向右翼的个体表现出适度的行为反弹。总体而言，结果表明，在刺激密集的零售环境中，碳食品标签显著改变习惯性食品消费模式的能力有限，因此应辅以额外的需求侧措施。
title: zero pu“Carbon food labels have limited effects on grocery shopping behavior: Evidence from a randomized experiment”
title_zh: 碳食品标签对杂货购物行为影响有限：来自随机实验的证据
